title: Command Not Found
description: deployctl exists in the workspace, but scripts expect it under local/bin and report command not found.
mission: Make an executable deployctl available at local/bin/deployctl without changing the original tool.
success: The expected executable path is available.

lesson.what_happened: The executable existed but was outside the path expected by the script.
lesson.be_careful: A shell PATH change only affects the relevant process and its children.

hints: local/bin can contain either the executable or a link to it.
Research ln -s and relative symbolic-link paths.
